group_results.reason: cJSON_Delete only adds NULL assignments after deallocate, and its deletion semantics are unchanged. The harness calls cJSON_Delete on every successful parse.

The parse_string failure path sets local output to NULL after freeing it and still returns false. The harness reaches it through cJSON_ParseWithOpts with malformed strings and handles the NULL result.
On the reallocate success path, print() sets buffer->buffer to NULL and still returns printed. The harness frees that result.
The print() failure and copy paths set pointers to NULL after free and still return NULL or printed. The harness checks for NULL before calling free.
When printing fails, cJSON_PrintBuffered sets p.buffer to NULL after freeing it and still returns NULL. The harness calls it with prebuffer 1 when the buffered flag is set.
The cJSON_free change only assigns NULL to its by-value parameter, which has no effect outside the function. The complete harness never calls cJSON_free and uses free().

build.reason: ossfuzz.sh builds static libcjson.a with CMake, then compiles cjson_read_fuzzer.c with $CXX and links it. The harness includes ../cJSON.h inside extern "C", and the declarations it uses are unchanged. The changes add only plain NULL stores to pointers that are already read, which is not a -Werror hazard.

input.reason: The harness requires 4 flag bytes and a trailing NUL. This keeps strlen in cJSON_ParseWithOpts bounded, and the parse API is unchanged.

lifecycle.reason: Printed output is freed once, the minify copy is freed once, and the tree is deleted once. The changes only set internal or local pointers to NULL after free.

control_flow.reason: The flag bytes select parse, buffered/formatted/unformatted printing and minify. The signatures of all public calls match the harness usage.
